hypotheses.C0_direct_formula_matches_native_state: Full-rank residual-plus-attention reconstruction reproduces the normalized pre-MLP state to maximum absolute error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.C1_direct64_reconstructs_semantic_local_: The 64+64 direct program reaches at least 0.80 median cosine for every Block 1-5 semantic MLP response.
hypotheses.C2_direct64_composes_through_suffix: The 64+64 direct program reaches at least 0.60 median source-gradient cosine at every source layer.
hypotheses.C3_direct256_composes_strongly: The 256+256 direct program reaches at least 0.80 median source-gradient cosine at every source layer.
hypotheses.C4_direct64_is_finitely_directional: Top-64 source-channel patches selected by the direct64 program have the correct finite direction on at least 90 percent of sites at every source layer.
hypotheses.C5_composition_improves_for_later_source: Direct64 median source-gradient cosine at Layer 3 exceeds Layer 0 by at least 0.15.
